ValidationRule.description: Freight Implementation: IATA # or eQ Customer # is mandatory, when Branch Account is created for International business.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight_Account" ),
OR(ISPICKVAL( Freight_Revenue_Stream__c , "INT"), (ISPICKVAL( Freight_Revenue_Stream__c , "DOM/INT"))),
ISPICKVAL( Type , "Freight-Branch"),
AND((ISBLANK(IATA_Number__c)) , (ISBLANK( Freight_eQ_Reference__c )))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter either an IATA # or eQ Customer # if Revenue Stream is International
